However, both available image-fetch mechanisms (WebFetch and any network-capable Bash command such as curl) require interactive approval that isn't obtainable in this non-interactive automated session, so no hero image could be downloaded. Per the rules, publication is abandoned rather than using no image or a fabricated/wrong one.
